mentions.name: Better Claude Plays Pokémon
mentions.description: This project aims to build an improved 'Claude Plays Pokémon'-style AI agent that plays through Pokémon games, with the end goal of completing hard nuzlocke challenges such as Run and Bun.
mentions.problem: Existing 'Claude Plays Pokémon' agents cannot complete hard nuzlocke challenges such as Run and Bun
mentions.audience: The author, as a personal fun project
mentions.source_excerpt: next fun thing is to try making a better "claude plays pokemon" i havent played emerald before, but the end goal is to get it to be able to play the hard nuzlockes like Run and Bun
